review_boundary.decision_basis: Frozen audit classifications plus the proposed narrow role and purpose only

allowed_content: categorical raw and protected access-closure status

manifest_derived_pending_candidates.ambiguity_rule: If an exact path, expected SHA-256, or allowed artifact class is not explicitly and unambiguously manifest-listed, emit no candidate and perform no search or inference.

prohibitions: No access to any R4 file other than the three exact hash-bound sources in this amendment.
No directory listing, recursive enumeration, globbing, repository search, sibling-path inference, existence probe, or path discovery outside the opened manifest text.
No opening, reading, previewing, hashing, statting, copying, transforming, executing, importing, or scientific use of any manifest-referenced file.
No protected, Night-2, Sealed Bank, protected-derived, fresh-final, confirmatory, quarantined, ambiguous, or Incident-001 value access or transfer.
No transfer of scientific measurements, candidate results, scores, metrics, thresholds, intervals, denominators, parameter values, counts, or other numerical scientific outcomes.
No scientific interpretation, proposal work, target ranking, tuning, selection, comparison, or evidentiary use.
No CLEAN_ALLOWLISTED, CLEAN, VERIFIED, or equivalent status may be assigned to any manifest-derived candidate.
No referenced artifact inherits the manifest's cleanliness, provenance class, permission, or evidence status.
No mutation of shared STATE, the official allowlist, an R4 file, or an R4 directory.
No role mixing with scientific worker, independent verifier, adversarial reviewer, final claim judge, or Root Orchestrator roles.

approval_basis: All three sources are already hash-bound and CLEAN_ALLOWLISTED in the frozen audit decisions.
The claim matrix and closeout were classified as bounded categorical or governance records without detected protected payload values or out-of-scope numerical scientific outcomes.
The manifest was classified as integrity metadata rather than scientific evidence, with all referenced artifacts expressly unreviewed.
The approved categorical output excludes numerical scientific values.
Manifest-derived paths and hashes remain PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT under default deny and confer no permission to access the referenced files.
Fresh role isolation and exact path/hash binding prevent the amendment from authorizing broader historical or scientific access.
rationale.scope_statement: This amendment authorizes a mechanical value-free sanitization and candidate-registration step only. It does not revise any scientific claim, declare any referenced artifact clean, or authorize repository inspection.

required_official_allowlist_changes_to_r.instruction: Add an audit receipt for IMPORT_ALLOWLIST/SANITIZER_PERMISSION_AMENDMENT.json using its final observed SHA-256.

required_official_allowlist_changes_to_r.change: Retain the newly approved role only on exact clean sources
required_official_allowlist_changes_to_r.instruction: Keep Evidence Sanitizer in permitted_roles for FINAL_CLAIM_MATRIX.json, ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json, and FINAL_CLOSEOUT.json only; do not add it to FINAL_REPORT.md or any referenced artifact.
For FINAL_CLAIM_MATRIX.json and FINAL_CLOSEOUT.json, replace the added purpose with exactly: derive value-free categorical R4 substrate only.

For ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json, replace the added purpose with exactly: extract exact manifest-listed code/config/parameter/detector/environment/input paths and expected SHA-256 values as PENDING_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT without opening or otherwise accessing referenced files.

Bind the prohibitions and approved-output constraints in this amendment to all Evidence Sanitizer access; preserve default DENY, no cleanliness inheritance, and the existing prohibited-use restrictions.
Increment the official allowlist version, update its freeze metadata, compute a new SHA-256, and obtain independent fidelity revalidation before Evidence Sanitizer access begins.
